summary: Source manifest cannot represent entry route with empty page_url
details: Fresh Kitchen source manifest set page_url to an empty string for the presell entry route. source-html-manifest/v0 rejects empty page_url when present, so prepare-build fell back to filesystem matching and lost explicit commerce shim mappings. Removed the empty page_url as workaround; schema/docs should specify entry-route representation.

summary: Source intake copy missed landing js assets
details: The preserved FreshPak landing referenced /landing/js/jquery-3.6.0.min.js, bookmarkscroll.js, jquery.scroller.js, jquery.accordion.js, and slick.js. The initial copied source-html contained css/images/video only, so doctor flagged built_output.script_missing until the js directory was copied from designer into source-html and page-kit assets.

summary: Doctor keeps static Olympus contract reminders after rendered replacements verify clean
details: After the Fresh build, rendered _site checkout contains only credit/apple-pay/google-pay rows and rooted runtime meta tags, and source frontmatter uses Fresh package/shipping refs. Doctor still emits spec.store_profile.payment_methods_default_on, routing_meta.runtime_root, and frontmatter.demoOnlyValues/replaceFromSpecOrApi reminders because those checks appear tied to CampaignSpec literals or the template contract rather than resolved built/source evidence. This forces agents to re-prove warnings manually.
